method: For an air-filled rectangular guide with broad wall a and narrow wall b, the dominant TE10 mode cuts off at fc = c / 2a with c = 299,792,458 m/s; TE20 cuts off at c / a, TE01 at c / 2b and TE11/TM11 at (c/2)·sqrt(1/a² + 1/b²). The lower of the TE20 and TE01 cutoffs is reported as the next mode and marks the top of the single-mode range, while the usable band is shown as 1.25 to 1.9 times the TE10 cutoff. At an operating frequency f above cutoff, the guide wavelength is the free-space wavelength divided by sqrt(1 - (fc/f)²), phase velocity is c divided by the same factor, group velocity is c times it, and the TE10 wave impedance is the free-space impedance (376.73 Ω) divided by it, so phase and group velocity multiply to c². Below cutoff the mode is evanescent and no wavelength or impedance is reported. A homogeneous dielectric filling would scale every cutoff by 1/sqrt(εr) and is not modelled.
